verdict.rationale: Dover's Premium tier lists an 'AI notetaker', and Dover connects to Zoom and collects structured interviewer feedback, so the core capability exists. However, there is only a single thin mention of the notetaker, with no documentation of how it records, transcribes, or summarizes interviews. missing for 10: documented recording/transcription details, AI summaries distilled into the scorecard, candidate consent handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews get AI notes and summaries — recorded, transcribed, and distilled into the scorecard with candidate consent handled

citations.quote: Premium is $199/month and adds AI applicant scoring, the AI notetaker, offer management with e-signing, bulk actions, and more.
collect structured feedback from every interviewer
